panels.description: One marker per country, sized by total queries over the selected time range. This is a playground stand-in for a proper choropleth — bubbles work out of the box with lat/lon; choropleth requires a GeoJSON gazetteer config to try later.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(s.city, 'Unknown') AS city,
  coalesce(s.country, 'Unknown') AS country,
  coalesce(s.country_iso, '??') AS country_iso,
  any(s.lat) AS lat,
  any(s.lon) AS lon,
  sum(o.value) AS queries
FROM dsc.observations o
LEFT JOIN dsc.sites s ON s.provider = o.provider AND s.site = o.site
WHERE o.dataset = 'qtype'
  AND o.site IN ($site)
  AND multiIf(o.key2='1','A',o.key2='2','NS',o.key2='5','CNAME',o.key2='6','SOA',o.key2='12','PTR',o.key2='15','MX',o.key2='16','TXT',o.key2='28','AAAA',o.key2='33','SRV',o.key2='43','DS',o.key2='46','RRSIG',o.key2='47','NSEC',o.key2='48','DNSKEY',o.key2='50','NSEC3',o.key2='52','TLSA',o.key2='59','CDS',o.key2='60','CDNSKEY',o.key2='62','CSYNC',o.key2='64','SVCB',o.key2='65','HTTPS',o.key2='255','ANY',o.key2='257','CAA',concat('TYPE',o.key2)) IN ($qtype)
  AND (
    '$region' = 'world'
    OR ('$region' = 'europe'  AND has(s.tags, 'Europe'))
    OR ('$region' = 'nordics' AND has(s.tags, 'Nordics'))
    OR ('$region' = 'sweden'  AND s.country_iso = 'SE')
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(o.timestamp)
  AND s.lat != 0
GROUP BY city, country, country_iso
ORDER BY queries DESC
